title: Diagnostic Accuracy Studies — Sensitivity, Likelihood Ratios and Spectrum Bias

hook.en: Every special test you do was once the subject of a study. But the numbers in the paper were produced in a particular group of patients, against a particular reference test. Learn to read a diagnostic study so that you know whether a test's reported accuracy will hold in your clinic.
hook.ur: Har special test jo aap karte hain kabhi kisi study ka mauzu tha. Lekin paper ke numbers ek khaas group ke mareezon mein, ek khaas reference test ke muqabale mein bane thay. Diagnostic study parhna seekhein taake pata chale ke test ki bayan shuda durusti aap ke clinic mein bhi rahegi ya nahi.

goal.en: By the end, you'll read a 2x2 table, explain sensitivity, specificity and likelihood ratios, use the STARD and QUADAS-2 ideas to check bias, and spot spectrum bias.
goal.ur: End tak aap 2x2 table parhenge, sensitivity, specificity aur likelihood ratios samjhayenge, bias jaanchne ke liye STARD aur QUADAS-2 ke khayalat istemal karenge, aur spectrum bias pehchanenge.

text.en: A **diagnostic accuracy study** compares an **index test** (the test being studied) with a **reference standard** (the best available way to know the truth, such as MRI or surgery) in the same patients. **Sensitivity** is the proportion of people with the condition that the test picks up; **specificity** is the proportion without the condition that the test correctly clears. **Likelihood ratios** turn these into how much a result changes your suspicion. Quality depends on who was tested, whether the reference standard was applied to everyone and whether those reading the tests were masked.
text.ur: **Diagnostic accuracy study** ek **index test** (jis ka study ho raha ho) ko ek **reference standard** (sachai jaanne ka behtareen tareeqa, jaise MRI ya surgery) se unhi mareezon mein milati hai. **Sensitivity** woh hissa hai un logon ka jinhein halat hai aur test pakadta hai; **specificity** woh hissa hai un logon ka jinhein halat nahi aur test sahi tareeqe se clear karta hai. **Likelihood ratios** inhein is mein badalte hain ke nateeja aap ke shak ko kitna badalta hai. Quality is par munhasir hai ke kis ka test hua, kya reference standard sab par laga aur kya tests parhne walay masked thay.

text.en: Think of **a metal detector at an airport**. High sensitivity means it beeps for nearly every dangerous item but may beep for keys too. High specificity means it stays quiet for harmless things but may miss a small knife. A test cannot be perfect at both, and what matters depends on the cost of missing something versus a false alarm.
text.ur: **Airport par metal detector** sochein. Zyada sensitivity ka matlab hai woh taqreeban har khatarnak cheez par bajta hai lekin chabiyon par bhi baj sakta hai. Zyada specificity ka matlab hai woh bezarar cheezon par chup rehta hai lekin chhota chaaqu chhod sakta hai. Test dono mein mukammal nahi ho sakta, aur kya ahem hai woh kisi cheez ke chhoot jane aur jhoote alarm ki qeemat par munhasir hai.

rows.en: Of people who have it, how many test positive?
rows.ur: Jinhein halat hai, un mein se kitne positive aate hain?

rows.en: A negative result on a highly sensitive test helps rule the condition out
rows.ur: Zyada sensitive test ka negative nateeja halat ko khaarij karne mein madad deta hai

rows.en: Of people who do not have it, how many test negative?
rows.ur: Jinhein halat nahi, un mein se kitne negative aate hain?

rows.en: A positive result on a highly specific test helps rule the condition in
rows.ur: Zyada specific test ka positive nateeja halat ko tasdeeq karne mein madad deta hai

rows.en: How much more likely a positive result is in people with the condition than without
rows.ur: Positive nateeja halat wale logon mein bina halat walon se kitna zyada mumkin hai

rows.en: Above 5 to 10 gives a large rise in suspicion
rows.ur: 5 se 10 se oopar shak mein bara izafa deta hai

rows.en: How much less likely a negative result is in people with the condition
rows.ur: Negative nateeja halat wale logon mein kitna kam mumkin hai

rows.en: Below 0.1 to 0.2 gives a large fall in suspicion
rows.ur: 0.1 se 0.2 se neeche shak mein bara kami deta hai

question.en: A test has high sensitivity and low specificity. A patient tests negative. What does this mean?
question.ur: Test ki sensitivity zyada aur specificity kam hai. Mareez negative aata hai. Is ka kya matlab hai?

text.en: The condition is unlikely, since a highly sensitive test rarely misses it (SnNout)
text.ur: Halat ka imkaan kam hai, kyunke zyada sensitive test isay shayad hi chhodta hai (SnNout)

feedback.en: Yes — a negative on a highly sensitive test helps rule out.
feedback.ur: Haan — zyada sensitive test ka negative khaarij karne mein madad deta hai.

feedback.en: A negative result points away from the condition.
feedback.ur: Negative nateeja halat se door ishara karta hai.

text.en: The test must have been done wrongly

feedback.en: There is no reason to think so.
feedback.ur: Aisa sochne ki koi wajah nahi.

question.en: A study tests a shoulder special test only in patients already booked for surgery, which gives excellent accuracy. Why might it be worse in your clinic?
question.ur: Ek study kandhe ka special test sirf un mareezon par karti hai jin ki surgery pehle se tay hai, jis se behtareen durusti milti hai. Aap ke clinic mein yeh kam kyun ho sakti hai?

text.en: The test only works for men
text.ur: Test sirf mardon par kaam karta hai

text.en: Spectrum bias: patients with severe, obvious disease are easier to detect than the mix of mild and unclear cases seen in clinic
text.ur: Spectrum bias: shadeed, wazeh bimari wale mareez clinic mein nazar aane wale halke aur ghair wazeh cases ke mila-jule se pehchanna aasaan hote hain

feedback.en: Yes — accuracy usually falls in patients like those you really see.
feedback.ur: Haan — durusti aam taur par un mareezon mein kam hoti hai jaise aap asal mein dekhte hain.

text.ur: Surgery wale mareez muaina nahi ho sakte

question.en: What does a masked reference standard reader protect against?
question.ur: Masked reference standard parhne wala kis se bachata hai?

text.en: Selection bias in who enters the study
text.ur: Study mein kaun shamil ho us ka selection bias

text.en: Review bias: knowing the index test result could change how the reference result is read
text.ur: Review bias: index test ka nateeja jaanna reference nateeje ko parhne ka tareeqa badal sakta hai

feedback.ur: Haan — masking ghair shuoori asar se bachati hai.

text.en: **Using sensitivity and specificity as fixed properties of a test.** They change with the patient group, the reference standard and how the test is performed. A test with 90 percent sensitivity in a specialist centre may perform worse in a general clinic. Another trap is relying on one test: tests are best combined with history and clusters of findings.
text.ur: **Sensitivity aur specificity ko test ki mustaqil khoobiyan samajhna.** Yeh mareezon ke group, reference standard aur test karne ke tareeqe ke saath badalti hain. Maahir markaz mein 90 fisad sensitivity wala test aam clinic mein kam kaam kar sakta hai. Ek aur jaal ek hi test par bharosa karna hai: tests tareekh aur findings ke clusters ke saath behtar hote hain.

text.en: **Use likelihood ratios to update your suspicion.** Start with your estimate before the test, for example "I think there is about a 30 percent chance of a rotator cuff tear". A test with a positive likelihood ratio of 5 raises that substantially. A test with a likelihood ratio near 1 barely changes anything, so do not rely on it.
text.ur: **Shak ko update karne ke liye likelihood ratios istemal karein.** Test se pehle apne andaaze se shuru karein, masalan "mera khayal hai rotator cuff tear ka takreeban 30 fisad imkaan hai". 5 ke positive likelihood ratio wala test isay kaafi barhata hai. 1 ke qareeb likelihood ratio wala test mushkil se kuch badalta hai, isliye us par bharosa na karein.

question.en: Can a test with 95 percent sensitivity and 95 percent specificity still give mostly false positives?
question.ur: Kya 95 fisad sensitivity aur 95 fisad specificity wala test phir bhi zyada tar jhoote positive de sakta hai?

answer.en: Yes, if the condition is rare. In 1,000 people with a 1 percent prevalence, 10 have it and the test catches about 9 to 10 of them, but 5 percent of the 990 without it, around 50, also test positive. Most positives are false. That is why the usefulness of a test depends on how common the condition is among those you test.
answer.ur: Haan, agar halat nadir ho. 1,000 logon mein 1 fisad prevalence ke saath 10 ko hai aur test unmein se 9 se 10 pakadta hai, lekin 990 mein se jinhein nahi hai 5 fisad, takreeban 50, bhi positive aate hain. Zyada tar positive jhoote hain. Isi liye test ki mufeediat is par munhasir hai ke jin ka aap test karte hain un mein halat kitni aam hai.

beats.patient: A new bedside test for deep vein thrombosis is reported to have 92 percent sensitivity and 88 percent specificity. The study enrolled patients from a vascular clinic and used ultrasound as the reference.
beats.assessment: The patients were likely to have obvious disease (spectrum bias), but the reference standard is reasonable.
beats.treatment: She notes that in her general physiotherapy clinic the prevalence is low, so many positives will be false and a negative will be more reliable, and she combines it with a clinical rule and refers any suspected case for ultrasound.
beats.reassess: She uses it to help rule out in low-risk patients and never to rule in without imaging.

text.en: **A negative test never excludes a dangerous diagnosis on its own.** For serious conditions such as fracture, vascular injury or cauda equina, use validated decision rules, your clinical judgement and a low threshold to refer. Do not skip imaging because a clinical test was negative if red flags are present.
text.ur: **Negative test akela khatarnak tashkhees ko khaarij nahi karta.** Fracture, vascular chot ya cauda equina jaisi seriyas halaton ke liye validated decision rules, apna clinical judgement aur refer ka kam threshold istemal karein. Agar red flags hon to clinical test negative aane par imaging na chhodein.

text.en: The STARD 2015 statement lists 30 essential items for reporting diagnostic accuracy studies, including how participants were selected, how the index test and reference standard were conducted and whether the readers were masked. QUADAS-2 is a tool to judge risk of bias and applicability in diagnostic accuracy studies, across four areas: patient selection, index test, reference standard, and flow and timing.
text.ur: STARD 2015 statement diagnostic accuracy studies ki report ke liye 30 lazmi items batata hai, jis mein shamil hai ke shirkat karne wale kaise chune gaye, index test aur reference standard kaise kiye gaye aur kya parhne walay masked thay. QUADAS-2 diagnostic accuracy studies mein risk of bias aur applicability parkhne ka aala hai, chaar hisson mein: mareez ka intikhab, index test, reference standard, aur flow aur timing.

text.en: **Sn rules out, Sp rules in, LR updates, Spectrum matters.** Sensitivity rules out, specificity rules in, likelihood ratios update, and the patient spectrum decides if it applies.
text.ur: **Sn khaarij, Sp tasdeeq, LR update, Spectrum ahem.** Sensitivity khaarij karti hai, specificity tasdeeq, likelihood ratios update karte hain, aur mareezon ka spectrum tay karta hai lagu hoga ya nahi.

summary.en: Diagnostic studies compare an index test with a reference standard; sensitivity helps rule out, specificity helps rule in.
summary.ur: Diagnostic studies index test ko reference standard se milati hain; sensitivity khaarij aur specificity tasdeeq karne mein madad deti hai.

summary.en: Likelihood ratios show how much a result changes your suspicion, and spectrum bias can inflate accuracy.
summary.ur: Likelihood ratios dikhate hain ke nateeja aap ke shak ko kitna badalta hai, aur spectrum bias durusti ko barha sakta hai.

summary.en: No clinical test alone excludes a serious diagnosis; combine tests, rules and judgement.
summary.ur: Koi clinical test akela seriyas tashkhees khaarij nahi karta; tests, rules aur judgement milayein.

back.en: The proportion of people with the condition that the test picks up.
back.ur: Halat wale logon ka woh hissa jo test pakadta hai.

back.en: Accuracy looks better because only obvious cases were studied.
back.ur: Durusti behtar lagti hai kyunke sirf wazeh cases ka study hua.

front.en: What does a likelihood ratio near 1 tell you?
front.ur: 1 ke qareeb likelihood ratio kya batata hai?

back.en: The test barely changes the probability.
back.ur: Test imkaan ko mushkil se badalta hai.

back.en: The best available way to know whether the condition is truly present.
back.ur: Yeh jaanne ka behtareen dastiyab tareeqa ke halat sach mein maujood hai ya nahi.

note.en: Why tests are best used in clusters.
note.ur: Tests clusters mein behtar kyun hote hain.
